4/15/24, 3:12 PM Minnesota Senate

The gavel is passed to Chair McEwen at 12:45pm.

Senator McEwen moved that S.F. 3428, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Judiciary and Public Safety
Committee. - MOTION ADOPTED.

S.F. 3638: Senator Marty: Oral fluid testing procedures authorization as a preemployment alternative for drug, alcohol, and
cannabis testing by employers.

Senator John Marty presented Senate File 3638.

Senator Marty moved the A-1 amendment to SF3638.
The amendment is adopted along a voice vote.

The following individuals testified in favor of SF3638, as amended:

Todd Gaynor, Reyer LLC

Jon Boesche, Government Relations Director, Associated Contractors & Builders of Minnesota & North Dakota
Discussion.

SF3638 is laid over as amended for potential omnibus inclusion.

Gavel is passed to Vice-Chair Hauschild at 1:01pm.

Senator McEwen moved that S.F. 3638, be laid over for possible inclusion in the omnibus bill. - MOTION ADOPTED.
S.F. 3852: Senator McEwen: Policy and technical changes to construction codes and licensing provisions.
Senator McEwen presented Senate File 3852.

Department of Labor & Industry, Director of Construction Codes and Licensing, Todd Green testified in favor of SF3852.

Discussion.

SF3852 is laid over for potential omnibus inclusion.

Senator Hauschild moved that S.F. 3852, be laid over for possible inclusion in the omnibus bill. - MOTION ADOPTED.

The meeting was adjourned at 1:13pm.

kL Lf Jack Fisther, Legislat

Assistant
